label: DCAT-AP 1.1
description: Archived 2015 final specification; property membership and obligations parsed from its pinned PDF tables.

dcat:dataset.usage_note: This property links the Catalogue with a Dataset that is part of the Catalogue.

dcat:record.usage_note: This property refers to a Catalogue Record that is part of the Catalogue

dcat:themeTaxonomy.usage_note: This property refers to a knowledge organization system used to classify the Catalogue's Datasets.

dct:description.usage_note: This property contains a free-text account of the Catalogue. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description. For further information on multilingual issues, please refer to section 8.

dct:hasPart.usage_note: This property refers to a related Catalogue that is part of the described Catalogue

dct:isPartOf.usage_note: This property refers to a related Catalogue in which the described Catalogue is physically or logically included.

dct:language.usage_note: This property refers to a language used in the textual metadata describing titles, descriptions, etc. of the Datasets in the Catalogue. This property can be repeated if the metadata is provided in multiple languages.

dct:license.usage_note: This property refers to the licence under which the Catalogue can be used or reused.

dct:publisher.usage_note: This property refers to an entity (organisation) responsible for making the Catalogue available.

vocabulary_guidance.usage_note: The corporate bodies NAL must be used for European institutions and a small set of international organisations. In case of other types of organisations, national, regional or local vocabularies should be used.

dct:rights.usage_note: This property refers to a statement that specifies rights associated with the Catalogue.

dct:spatial.usage_note: This property refers to a geographical area covered by the Catalogue.

vocabulary_guidance.usage_note: The MDR Name Authority Lists must be used for continents, countries and places in those lists; if a particular location is not in one of the mentioned lists, GeoNames URIs must be used.

dct:title.usage_note: This property contains a name given to the Catalogue. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the name.

foaf:homepage.usage_note: This property refers to a web page that acts as the main page for the Catalogue.

adms:status.usage_note: This property refers to the type of the latest revision of a Dataset's entry in the Catalogue. It MUST take one of the values :created, :updated or :deleted depending on whether his latest revision is a result of a creation, update or deletion.

dct:conformsTo.usage_note: This property refers to an Application Profile hat the Dataset’s metadata conforms to

dct:description.usage_note: This property contains a free-text account of the record. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description.

dct:issued.usage_note: This property contains the date on which the description of the Dataset was included in the Catalogue.

dct:language.usage_note: This property refers to a language used in the textual metadata describing titles, descriptions, etc. of the Dataset. This property can be repeated if the metadata is provided in multiple languages.

dct:modified.usage_note: This property contains the most recent date on which the Catalogue entry was changed or modified.

dct:source.usage_note: This property refers to the original metadata that was used in creating metadata for the Dataset

dct:title.usage_note: This property contains a name given to the Catalogue Record. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the name.

foaf:primaryTopic.usage_note: This property links the Catalogue Record to the Dataset described in the record.

adms:identifier.usage_note: This property refers to a secondary identifier of the Dataset, such as MAST/ADS18, DataCite19, DOI20, EZID21 or W3ID22.

adms:sample.usage_note: This property refers to a sample distribution of the dataset

adms:versionNotes.usage_note: This property contains a description of the differences between this version and a previous version of the Dataset. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the version notes.

dcat:contactPoint.usage_note: This property contains contact information that can be used for sending comments about the Dataset.

dcat:distribution.usage_note: This property links the Dataset to an available Distribution.

dcat:keyword.usage_note: This property contains a keyword or tag describing the Dataset.

dcat:landingPage.usage_note: This property refers to a web page that provides access to the Dataset, its Distributions and/or additional information. It is intended to point to a landing page at the original data provider, not to a page on a site of a third party, such as an aggregator.

dcat:theme.usage_note: This property refers to a category of the Dataset. A Dataset may be associated with multiple themes.

dct:accessRights.usage_note: This property refers to information that indicates whether the Dataset is open data, has access restrictions or is not public. A controlled vocabulary with three members (:public, :restricted, :non-public) will be created and maintained by the Publications Office of the EU.

dct:accrualPeriodicity.usage_note: This property refers to the frequency at which the Dataset is updated.

dct:conformsTo.usage_note: This property refers to an implementing rule or other specification.

dct:description.usage_note: This property contains a free-text account of the Dataset. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description.

dct:hasVersion.usage_note: This property refers to a related Dataset that is a version, edition, or adaptation of the described Dataset.

dct:identifier.usage_note: This property contains the main identifier for the Dataset, e.g. the URI or other unique identifier in the context of the Catalogue.

dct:isVersionOf.usage_note: This property refers to a related Dataset of which the described Dataset is a version, edition, or adaptation.

dct:issued.usage_note: This property contains the date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the Dataset.

dct:language.usage_note: This property refers to a language of the Dataset. This property can be repeated if there are multiple languages in the Dataset.

dct:modified.usage_note: This property contains the most recent date on which the Dataset was changed or modified.

dct:provenance.usage_note: This property contains a statement about the lineage of a Dataset.

dct:publisher.usage_note: This property refers to an entity (organisation) responsible for making the Dataset available.

vocabulary_guidance.usage_note: The corporate bodies NAL must be used for European institutions and a small set of international organisations. In case of other types of organisations, national, regional or local vocabularies should be used.

dct:relation.usage_note: This property refers to a related resource.

dct:source.usage_note: This property refers to a related Dataset from which the described Dataset is derived.

dct:spatial.usage_note: This property refers to a geographic region that is covered by the Dataset.

vocabulary_guidance.usage_note: The MDR Name Authority Lists must be used for continents, countries and places in those lists; if a particular location is not in one of the mentioned lists, GeoNames URIs must be used.

dct:temporal.usage_note: This property refers to a temporal period that the Dataset covers.

dct:title.usage_note: This property contains a name given to the Dataset. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the name.

dct:type.usage_note: This property refers to the type of the Dataset. A controlled vocabulary for the values has not been established.

foaf:page.usage_note: This property refers to a page or document about this Dataset.

owl:versionInfo.usage_note: This property contains a version number or other version designation of the Dataset.

adms:status.usage_note: This property refers to the maturity of the Distribution

dcat:accessURL.usage_note: This property contains a URL that gives access to a Distribution of the Dataset. The resource at the access URL may contain information about how to get the Dataset.

dcat:byteSize.usage_note: This property contains the size of a Distribution in bytes.

dcat:downloadURL.usage_note: This property contains a URL that is a direct link to a downloadable file in a given format.

dcat:mediaType.usage_note: This property refers to the media type of the Distribution as defined in the official register of media types managed by IANA.

dct:conformsTo.usage_note: This property refers to an established schema to which the described Distribution conforms.

dct:description.usage_note: This property contains a free-text account of the Distribution. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description.

dct:format.usage_note: This property refers to the file format of the Distribution.

dct:issued.usage_note: This property contains the date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the Distribution.

dct:language.usage_note: This property refers to a language used in the Distribution. This property can be repeated if the metadata is provided in multiple languages.

dct:license.usage_note: This property refers to the licence under which the Distribution is made available.

dct:modified.usage_note: This property contains the most recent date on which the Distribution was changed or modified.

dct:rights.usage_note: This property refers to a statement that specifies rights associated with the Distribution.

dct:title.usage_note: This property contains a name given to the Distribution. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description.

foaf:page.usage_note: This property refers to a page or document about this Distribution.

spdx:checksum.usage_note: This property provides a mechanism that can be used to verify that the contents of a distribution have not changed

dct:type.usage_note: This property refers to a type of licence, e.g. indicating ‘public domain’ or ‘royalties required’.
This property refers to a type of the agent that makes the Catalogue or Dataset available

foaf:name.usage_note: This property contains a name of the agent. This property can be repeated for different versions of the name (e.g. the name in different languages)

skos:prefLabel.usage_note: This property contains a preferred label of the category. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the label.

dct:title.usage_note: This property contains a name of the category scheme. May be repeated for different versions of the name

spdx:algorithm.usage_note: This property identifies the algorithm used to produce the subject Checksum. Currently, SHA-1 is the only supported algorithm. It is anticipated that other algorithms will be supported at a later time.

spdx:checksumValue.usage_note: This property provides a lower case hexadecimal encoded digest value produced using a specific algorithm.
